snippet.title: ORKEN: ANNOUNCEMENT TRAILER
snippet.description:
All footage captured in-engine

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4146090/Orken/ 
Follow on Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sixmorevodka/orken 
Join Discord: https://discord.gg/sixmorevodka

This is *Sixmorevodka’s* first leap into the world of videogames, in close collaboration with *Demagog Studio* (creators of _Golf Club: Nostalgia, Highwater, & The Cub_ ). Small team. Big ambitions. No trends chased. No corners cut. 

*ORKEN* is a *Neanderthal Western* – _Orcs vs Humans, Stone vs Steel_ – built as an _independent_ *AA action-RPG* , blending *Mass Effect’s storytelling* with *Soulslike combat* , wrapped in the bold visual style of *Hi-Fi Rush* .

The *FREE DEMO* launches on Steam: *26.02.26*
*KICKSTARTER* goes Live: *26.02.26*

Watch the trailer. Let us know what you think.

Subscribe for future updates, reveals, and behind-the-scenes looks. 

Orkenworld: https://www.orkenworld.com
Sixmorevodka: https://www.sixmorevodka.com
Demagog Studio: https://www.demagogstudio.com
